faq.howDoIAssignTheTwoApexRanks: How do I assign the two Apex ranks?
faq.signInOnTheAccountPageAsTheMinecraft: Sign in on the account page as the Minecraft player who received LIFETIME + 2 APEX. Enter a different Minecraft username for each rank and confirm. Recipients must have joined 6b6t. Each assignment is permanent and cannot be transferred.
